name: Eating Too Much Food
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of overindulgence, particularly in food and drink, highlighting the loss of wisdom and self-control that results from excessive appetite. Proverbs cautions the believer to exercise strict discipline, even to the point of restraining one’s desires, as those who indulge in riotous eating and drinking stray from godly judgment. The example of Jesus fasting and experiencing hunger underscores the importance of mastery over bodily cravings. Together, these verses reveal that eating too much is not merely a physical issue but a spiritual challenge that calls for sober vigilance and reliance on God’s strength.
